name: minimax-h3-fast
description: H3-Fast is a high-speed video generation model post-trained and optimized from the standard MiniMax H3. It generates 480p or 768p videos up to 15 seconds and supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and multi-subject reference-based generation. Designed for fast, cost-efficient batch creation while maintaining strong visual quality and reference fidelity, it is well suited for e-commerce, advertising, marketing, and other high-volume content workflows.
zhDescription: H3-Fast是基于MiniMax-H3标准版本后训练调优的极速生成版本视频生成模型，480P / 768P 分辨率视频直出，最长可输出视频时长为15s，支持文生视频、图生视频、多主体参考生成视频，在大幅度提速降本的同时，效果极佳；参考生效果佳；适用于电商、广告、营销等各领域视频素材的极速批量生成，价格便宜，是一款极具性价比的视频生成模型。
longDescription: H3-Fast is a high-speed video generation model post-trained and optimized from the standard MiniMax H3. It generates 480p or 768p videos up to 15 seconds and supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and multi-subject reference-based generation. Designed for fast, cost-efficient batch creation while maintaining strong visual quality and reference fidelity, it is well suited for e-commerce, advertising, marketing, and other high-volume content workflows.
